[[Silverwood/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:SilverwoodZV.png|200px]] | pic2-text = Possible paths | ingame name=Silverwood | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=043 }} [[Silverwood]] is a lush area of the [[Maguuma Jungle]] populated largely by [[centaur]]s. A [[Shining Blade]] outpost lies near the center of the area, at the [[Quarrel Falls]]. ==Getting there== Exit from Quarrel Falls or [[Bloodstone Fen (outpost)|Bloodstone Fen]]. Alternatively, the quest [[Mysterious Message (Prophecies quest)|Mysterious Message]] will lead you here from [[Druid's Overlook]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *North, near [[Alari Doubleblade]]. *Northwest, near the exit to Bloodstone Fen. *South, near the exit to Quarrel Falls. *Southwest, near the exit to [[Ettin's Back]]. ==Quests available== *Alari Doubleblade **[[The Price of Steel]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 [[Crispin Bryllis]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Jungle Troll Tusk]]s) *{{x}} 1 [[Farmer Conklin]] (collector for 5 [[Mossy Mandible]]s) *{{x}} 2 [[Lady Engelram]] (collector for 5 [[Maguuma Mane]]s) *{{x}} [[Alari Doubleblade]] ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 [[Warthog]] ===Foes=== [[Centaur]]s *{{w}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Warrior]] *{{r}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Hunter]] *{{mo}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Protector]] [[Rider]]s *{{me}} 12,17 (24,25) [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Rider]] [[Scarab]]s *{{n}} 12,16 (24,25) [[Moss Scarab]] [[Troll]]s *{{w}}{{r}} 14 (24) [[Jungle Troll]] ===Bosses=== [[Centaur]]s *{{w}} 18 (28) [[Hovi Bravetail]] *{{r}} 18 (28) [[Keba Silenthoof]] *{{mo}} 19 (29) [[Woho Sacredhide]] *{{n}} 19 (29) [[Numa Plaguemane]] *{{me}} 19 (29) [[Bolo Falsehoof]] *{{e}} 19 (29) [[Lala Firemane]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|The Silverwastes}} [[File:Silverwood end of the world.jpg|thumb|[[End of the world]] past the portal into Ettin's Back.]] *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. **It is possible to walk through the portal leading to [[Ettin's Back]] without [[Zone#Zoning|zoning]] into that area. Note that this does not yield otherwise non-explorable parts of the map. *{{Vanquisher|count = 210|low = 185|high = 221}} **There are hidden groups of [[Moss Scarab]]s.There are no [[Life Pod]]s. **There are two groups of three [[Maguuma Hunter]]s that are easily missed. One group patrols a long route in the northwestern corner of the map, south of [[Bloodstone Fen (outpost)|Bloodstone Fen]]. The other patrols in the south. **Mind also the lone [[Wind Rider (Maguuma Jungle)|Wind Rider]] that patrols the fountain area in the northeast. **With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the [[Temple of the Ages]]. {{Anomaly|Just outside the entrance to [[Bloodstone Fen]], there is an area that appears to keep "foggy" as if unexplored.}} {{Explorable areas in the Maguuma Jungle}} [[de:Silberholz]]
